text: All fixed. The root cause was in `is_leap` in `isodate/dates.py`: it only checked `year % 4 == 0`, so century years like 1900 and 2100 were incorrectly treated as leap years, giving February 29 days and inflating `days_between` by one. The fix applies the full Gregorian rule (divisible by 4, except centuries unless divisible by 400), which also corrects `ordinal` for all dates after 1900. No new dependencies were added, per the maintainer's request.
